claims.claim: Conditional real-event donors repaired pre-fit support but failed calibration quality.
Causality-preserving and causality-disturbing augmentation is a documented multivariate anomaly-detection strategy.
claims.limitation: Not the same label regime or metric as P1.

claims.claim: Time-aware MIL is designed to localize sparse temporal patterns from weak supervision.
claims.limitation: Classification localization does not guarantee interval F1.

claims.claim: The current quasi-periodic residual pilot was statistically positive in sign but operationally a near no-op and failed effect/fold gates.
claims.limitation: Architecture-fresh commitment on historically exposed folds.

claims.claim: GPR has been used for joint depth-level temperature and salinity anomaly reconstruction and provides uncertainty.
claims.limitation: Different basin, sampling system, and target.

claims.claim: Internal tides can be represented as density-surface vertical displacements with a two-mode approximation.
claims.limitation: Deep glider/steric-height result is not a P2 effect-size estimate.

claims.claim: ERA5 pretraining beat persistence on source data and beat a matched local-only CatBoost control after continuation, but did not beat the incumbent.
claims.limitation: Local historical evidence only; domain AUC is near one.

claims.claim: ERA5 atmospheric HRES is about 31 km and wave data use a different approximately 0.36 degree grid.
claims.limitation: Documentation does not quantify buoy-site transfer error.

claims.claim: CatBoost GPU training is nondeterministic due to floating-point summation order.
claims.limitation: CPU determinism still depends on the frozen environment and seed.

claims.claim: TimeXer explicitly separates endogenous patches and exogenous variables through self- and cross-attention.
claims.limitation: Benchmark evidence is not wave-transfer proof.
